# Taste — a curated index of UI, motion, shader and WebGL craft

> A hand-picked catalog of the best UI libraries, animation kits, shaders and WebGL tools, and the people who made them. Hover any entry for a live preview, copy the install command, then go read their best work.

## Docs

- Browse the index: https://taste.11xui.com/browse
- Curation guide: https://taste.11xui.com/about
- Add an entry: https://taste.11xui.com/about
- Source: https://github.com/gauravmandall/taste
- Curator: https://x.com/intent/follow?screen_name=gauravmandall

## Project structure

- `registry/entries/*.json` — entry data (50 files, one per tool)
- `registry/categories.json` — 5 categories: ui, animation, webgl, shaders, tools
- `scripts/build-registry.mjs` — compiles JSON files into typed TS module
- `lib/registry.ts` — type definitions and helper functions
- `lib/registry-data.ts` — auto-generated (gitignored)
- `components/` — React components
- `app/` — Next.js App Router pages

## Entry schema

Each entry in `registry/entries/{slug}.json` has: slug, name, tagline, description, url, category, tags, embeddable, optional install (npm/shadcn), makers array (name, role, x, github, site), best work links, optional featured flag.

## Categories

| id | label | count |
|---|---|---|
| ui | UI libraries | 18 |
| animation | Animation | 10 |
| webgl | 3D / WebGL | 9 |
| shaders | Shaders | 5 |
| tools | Tools | 6 |

## Featured entries (editor's picks)

Base UI, Bklit UI, Codrops, GSAP, Lygia, Magic UI, Motion, Paper Shaders, Radix UI, React Three Fiber, shadcn/ui, Shadertoy, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Vaul

## Routes

- `/` — homepage with hero, category strip, picks, makers marquee, recent entries
- `/browse` — full searchable index with category filter
- `/browse?c={id}` — filtered by category
- `/t/{slug}` — detail page for an entry
- `/about` — curation rules

## Stack

Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI, Lucide React, Geist/Geist Mono, Vercel Analytics
